source_text: Secundae prophetiae Balaam initium sumimus. Balac attonitus benedictiones pro maledictionibus audit.
pass_a_gloss: Of-second prophecy of-Balaam beginning we-take. Balak astonished blessings for curses hears.
pass_b_english: We take up Balaam’s [[second prophecy >> Bible:Numbers 23:11-24]]. Balak is stunned to hear blessings instead of curses.
